facts.text: The simulation-tool market is best understood as layers rather than mutually exclusive products.
facts.quote: The market is best understood as layers rather than as mutually exclusive products.

facts.text: A complete simulation platform usually still relies on a separate vehicle model, controller, ECU, asset pipeline or HIL system.
facts.quote: A "complete platform" usually still relies on a separate vehicle model, controller, ECU, asset pipeline or HIL system

facts.text: A specialist physics engine can be technically superior in one layer while being a poor substitute for a validation-management platform.
facts.quote: a specialist physics engine can be technically superior in one layer while being a poor substitute for a validation-management platform.

facts.text: Complete and near-complete simulation platforms include MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink with the Offroad Autonomy Library and RoadRunner, Applied Intuition, Cognata, and Duality AI Falcon.
facts.quote: MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink with the Offroad Autonomy Library and RoadRunner; Applied Intuition; Cognata; Duality AI Falcon;

facts.text: Complete and near-complete simulation platforms include Cadence (formerly Hexagon) Virtual Test Drive (VTD) and VTDx, and IPG Automotive CarMaker/TruckMaker with its off-highway stack.
facts.quote: Cadence (formerly Hexagon) Virtual Test Drive (VTD) and VTDx; IPG Automotive CarMaker/TruckMaker and its off-highway stack;

facts.text: Complete and near-complete simulation platforms include dSPACE AURELION with SIMPHERA and Siemens Simcenter Prescan.
facts.quote: dSPACE AURELION with SIMPHERA; Siemens Simcenter Prescan;

facts.text: CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Project Chrono and Gazebo are open-source complete or near-complete simulation platforms; Project Chrono is also a dynamics engine.
facts.quote: CARLA (open source); NVIDIA Isaac Sim (open source); Project Chrono (open source, also a dynamics engine); BeamNG.tech; MORAI; rFpro; Gazebo (open source).

facts.text: BeamNG.tech, MORAI and rFpro are complete or near-complete simulation platforms.
facts.quote: BeamNG.tech; MORAI; rFpro;

facts.text: Sensor simulation offerings include dSPACE AURELION, Synopsys (formerly Ansys) AVxcelerate Sensors, and Simcenter Prescan sensor models.
facts.quote: dSPACE AURELION; Synopsys (formerly Ansys) AVxcelerate Sensors; Simcenter Prescan sensor models;

facts.text: Sensor simulation offerings include NVIDIA RTX sensors in Isaac Sim, Chrono::Sensor, CARLA sensors and rFpro's camera pipeline.
facts.quote: NVIDIA RTX sensors in Isaac Sim; Chrono::Sensor; CARLA sensors; rFpro's camera pipeline;

facts.text: Persival offers sensor models as a service.
facts.quote: Persival (sensor models as a service).

facts.text: Vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil offerings include Mevea, Algoryx AGX Dynamics with AGX Terrain, Tire, Tracks, Hydraulics and Granular, and CM Labs Vortex Studio.
facts.quote: Mevea; Algoryx AGX Dynamics (with AGX Terrain, Tire, Tracks, Hydraulics, Granular); CM Labs Vortex Studio;

facts.text: Project Chrono provides SCM, CRM and DEM terrain capabilities in the vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil category.
facts.quote: Project Chrono (SCM, CRM and DEM terrain)

facts.text: Vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil offerings include Applied Intuition CarSim/TruckSim, Simcenter EDEM, Fraunhofer ITWM IPS Demify and MSC/Cadence Adams.

facts.text: MathWorks Vehicle Dynamics Blockset and Simscape are offerings in the vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil category.
facts.quote: MathWorks Vehicle Dynamics Blockset and Simscape.

facts.text: Environment creation and reconstruction offerings include RoadRunner, RoadRunner Scene Builder, and Unreal Engine ecosystems involving Falcon Editor, CARLA and MathWorks.
facts.quote: RoadRunner, RoadRunner Scene Builder; Unreal Engine ecosystems (Falcon Editor, CARLA, MathWorks);

facts.text: Environment creation and reconstruction offerings include NVIDIA NuRec Gaussian splatting, OpenUSD and Omniverse tooling, and Fraunhofer ITWM VMC Road & Scene-Generator.

facts.text: ASAM OpenMATERIAL 3D is identified as the material standard for environment creation and reconstruction.

facts.text: Scenario generation and test management offerings include ASAM OpenSCENARIO and OpenDRIVE, Foretellix Foretify, AVL SCENIUS and RoadRunner Scenario.

facts.text: Scenario generation and test management offerings include VTD 2025.2 ScenarioEngine, dSPACE SIMPHERA, open-source Scenic and Applied Intuition's scenario tooling.
facts.quote: VTD 2025.2 ScenarioEngine; dSPACE SIMPHERA; Scenic (open source); Applied Intuition's scenario tooling.
